role: Post-open two-implementation envelope diagnostic deciding whether K14-to-K16 under-iteration is monotone even under the most adverse componentwise combination of the two already sealed parent metric replicas.
scientific_question: When the formal and independent v244.2 metric replicas are treated as a componentwise uncertainty envelope rather than forced to agree numerically, does zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS improve from K14 to K16 robustly enough to authorize one fixed K20 reference run?

unique_primary.name: componentwise_two_implementation_envelope_k14_to_k16_monotone_underiteration
unique_primary.lower_bound_definition: For each arm, rig, frame and metric, elementwise minimum of the sealed formal and independent parent replicas.
unique_primary.upper_bound_definition: For each arm, rig, frame and metric, elementwise maximum of the sealed formal and independent parent replicas.
unique_primary.definitely_safe_cell_definition: All four upper metric bounds are less than or equal to the frozen strict cell limits.
unique_primary.possible_k16_failed_component_definition: The K16 upper metric bound is greater than its frozen strict limit.
unique_primary.worst_case_gain_definition: K14 lower metric bound minus K16 upper metric bound for every possible K16 failed component.
unique_primary.worst_case_remaining_gap_definition: K16 upper metric bound minus the frozen strict limit for every possible K16 failed component.
unique_primary.worst_case_repeat_gain_ratio_definition: Worst-case remaining gap divided by worst-case gain.
unique_primary.robust_safe_set_requirement: The K16 definitely-safe set must be a strict superset of the K14 definitely-safe set.
unique_primary.robust_component_requirement: Every possible K16 failed component must have strictly positive worst-case gain and repeat-gain ratio at most one.
unique_primary.robust_p90_requirement: For every rig and metric, higher-quantile p90 of the K16 upper bounds must be less than or equal to higher-quantile p90 of the K14 lower bounds.
unique_primary.robust_worst_requirement: For every rig and metric, maximum K16 upper bound must be less than or equal to maximum K14 lower bound.
unique_primary.k20_reason: K20 adds two fixed two-iteration blocks beyond K16: one registered crossing block and one fixed margin block.

formal_method.input: Read both sealed parent metric replicas after verifying all parent and v245-failure byte identities.
formal_method.implementation: Vectorized NumPy lower/upper envelopes, masks and method=higher quantiles.
formal_method.output: One JSON report and READY seal in a previously absent fixed output directory.

independent_method.input: Read the same two sealed parent metric replicas after the formal report is sealed and all identities are reverified.
independent_method.implementation: Explicit arm/rig/frame/metric loops, scalar min/max and sorted-index higher quantiles; do not import the formal v246 implementation.
independent_method.required_agreement: All counts, index sets, envelope values used by failed components, rig tails, booleans and final decision agree within 1e-12; discrete values agree exactly.

decision_order: Any source, protocol, parent, v245-failure, shape, dtype, finite, output-exclusivity, formal-independent or seal mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_REFERENCE_ENVELOPE_V246.

If any robust safe-set, component-gain, repeat-gain, p90 or worst predicate fails, conclude FAIL_CASE19_TWO_IMPLEMENTATION_ENVELOPE_NOT_MONOTONE_V246 and close deeper fixed-reference runs under this mechanism.

Only if every validity and robust-envelope predicate passes in both v246 implementations may conclude PASS_CASE19_ROBUST_ENVELOPE_AUTHORIZES_FIXED_K20_REFERENCE_V246 and authorize one separately frozen K20 reference run.
A pass does not repair v244.2 or v245, and does not authorize a warm candidate, predictor, wall/RSS, unopened condition, neural model, GPU, external-generalization claim or real-BOST claim.
failure_action: Close fixed-depth reference deepening for the current global geometry-Jacobi PCGLS mechanism. Do not search K18/K20/K22/K24/K32, alter the envelope, add tolerances, tune preconditioning or use another opened case to rescue it.
